50202001.text: Atea... is an elder I deeply respect.

50202002.text: After my grandfather died, the elders voted for me to become the chief of our tribe.

50202003.text: I always have a lot of new and crazy ideas, so everyone believed I could lead our tribe towards a different kind of future.

50202004.text: For a long time, though, I had no idea what to do.

50202005.text: But, Atea was always there to encourage me. Even when I made mistakes, she never made me feel bad for messing up. She'd help me analyze what went wrong and help me do better next time.

50202006.text: She's someone I really respect, so... I'll remember what she taught me, and work hard to become the chief our tribe deserves.
